related_questions.question: How to check if COVID is gone?
related_questions.snippet: You'll know you're getting better once your symptoms lessen or disappear altogether. Signs that COVID is getting better vary from person to person and depend on your symptoms. For example, if you had a fever for several days but are now fever free without taking a fever-reducing medicine, that's a sign of recovery.

related_questions.question: What to do if you have COVID-19 Mayo Clinic?
related_questions.snippet: If you have COVID-19 , it's important to get plenty of rest, drink fluids and keep an eye on your symptoms. Medicines you can get without a prescription can help manage pain, fever or cough. If you have COVID-19 and are staying separate from others, try to keep busy and help your body clear out the infection.
